section.para: Here is a graph of the accumulated rainfall in Las Vegas, Nevada, in the first 60 days of 2017.

image.alt: CONTINUOUS GRAPH WITH TITLE OF ACCUMULATED RAINFALL, LAS VEGAS, NEVADA, X-AXIS LABEL OF DAY OF THE YEAR 2017, AND Y-AXIS LABEL OF RAINFALL IN INCHES. THE X-AXIS GOES FROM 0 TO 60 IN INCREMENTS OF 10. THE Y-AXIS GOES FROM 0 TO 1-POINT-6 IN INCREMENTS OF 0-POINT-2.

section.para: Use the graph to support your answers to the following questions.

div.para: Yes. For each number of days \(d\) between 0 and 60, a certain amount of rain fell up to that time, so there is one particular value for the accumulated rain at any point in time.

list.item: Is the accumulated amount of rainfall a function of time?

div.para: No. There was no rainfall in the first 10 days. This means that for the amount of rainfall 0 inches, or for the input value of 0, there are lots of times \(d\) that could be the output.
